title: Insights Hub: reconciliation pass, microinteraction polish, and QA-ready handoff
creator: Asha Menon
description: This ticket captures the final visual reconciliation pass for the new Insights Hub (dashboard + route-level drilldowns) and prepares a QA-ready handoff for engineering. Work focuses on: 1) reconciling stakeholder feedback from the last PM/Eng design review, 2) final microinteraction specs for row/column hover and compact density modes, 3) accessibility contrast & focus states pass, and 4) packaging Figma prototypes and QA checklist for SRE/FE implementers. The intent is to freeze visual tokens, motion timing, and tolerant responsive rules so the engineering implementation has clear acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Final Figma prototype v2 published with both desktop and compact breakpoints
Microinteraction spec sheet attached (hover states, skeleton loading, empty states, error states, inline toasts)
Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for primary text and >= 3:1 for supportive labels; documented exceptions with rationale
Edge-case doc for nested rollups (more than 50 rows) and pagination behavior delivered
QA checklist completed and signed off by PM and Eng lead
PRD link to final requirements present in links and referenced in handoff notes
decisions: Adopt 120ms ease-out for hover reveal of row actions to balance perceived responsiveness and prevent accidental triggers
Keep cost microview sparklines as non-interactive visuals at <= 280px width; full sparkline drill opens the detail panel
Show a condensed row density by default for accounts with >500 routes; user preference persisted in profile settings
Fallback color for alert chips will be the brand-warning-alt token to meet contrast targets on dark mode
